implementation_summary: Introduced ConnectedApp inner component inside MarmotProvider to access useMarmot() (client, signer, relays) for the forgetSelfDevice call. Extracted performDisconnect from handleDisconnect in Page. handleDisconnect now opens a two-path AlertDialog. ConnectedApp owns forgetInFlight state for double-click guard. The plain sign-out path calls performDisconnect() directly; the forget path calls forgetSelfDevice(client, signer, relays, performDisconnect) with try/catch fallback.
